source.title: Zippo click sound
source.author: dawith (submitted by qubodup)
source.notes: 44.1 kHz stereo FLAC, 0.5 s: one soft mechanical click of about 30 ms (a Zippo lighter), the rest digital silence. OpenGameArt, 2012-06-02. Not the source of the old utility_draw (r 0.15 at any speed). Softened with a high shelf (-12 dB above 2.5 kHz; its energy peaked at 3-5 and 8-12 kHz) and 3 dB quieter.
